items.title: Quantum-resistant signing on AWS, Part 1: Build a software supply chain with ML-DSA
items.summary: Software supply chain attacks have grown in both frequency and sophistication. Recent high-profile compromises of build systems and open source dependencies demonstrate that attackers increasingly target the trust mechanisms that verify software integrity.
